candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] AK105 (other names: Penpulimab Injection): AK105 is a humanized monoclonal antibody that specifically binds to PD-1.
[DRUG] Anlotinib (other names: Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules): Anlotinib a multi-target receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study of AK105 With Anlotinib and Radiotherapy Adjuvant Therapy in MGMT Unmethylated Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] AK105 injection with anlotinib and radiotherapy: AK105 200mg intravenously (IV) on day 1 of each 21-day cycle until disease progression or treatment intolerance, the dose can not be adjusted.

coder_notes: Single-arm: penpulimab (AK105) + anlotinib + radiotherapy without temozolomide in MGMT-unmethylated newly diagnosed GBM. Both drugs are investigational, so experimental_combination. Anlotinib salt (hydrochloride) mapped to parent; no INN given in the record. MGMT unmethylation is an entry requirement, not candidate-matched.
